dialogues.jp:
風紀委員の仕事ってのは、思っていたよりもかっ
たるかった……。
dialogues.en:
The work of the school committee is much more troublesome
than I imagined.
dialogues.text:
The work of the school committee is much more troublesome
than I imagined.

dialogues.jp: というか、こき使われている。
dialogues.en: Or should I call it slavery?
dialogues.text: Or should I call it slavery?

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「はい、次は白河先生に体育館の鍵を返してか
　ら、抜き打ちで各教室を回って違法品を没収
　していきます」
dialogues.en:
"Okay, today we're going to return the gym key to
Shirakawa-sensei, and go around the classrooms at random and
confiscate any illegal items."
dialogues.text:
"Okay, today we're going to return the gym key to
Shirakawa-sensei, and go around the classrooms at random and
confiscate any illegal items."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「違法品？」
dialogues.en: "Illegal items?"
dialogues.text: "Illegal items?"

dialogues.jp:
新聞部の印刷機を借りて作られたというチラシ
の束を腕に、危ない雰囲気の単語に反応する。
dialogues.en:
As I reacted to the dangerous sounding words, I almost
dropped the bundle of fliers I was carrying.
dialogues.text:
As I reacted to the dangerous sounding words, I almost
dropped the bundle of fliers I was carrying.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「うん、これがね、意外と危険なモノをみんな
　して作ってるのよ……」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah. You'd be surprised how many people are making
dangerous stuff......"
dialogues.text:
"Yeah. You'd be surprised how many people are making
dangerous stuff......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「今までの卒業パーティーの歴史で、演劇部が
　ラストで爆発シーンをやりたいからって、科
　学部と共謀して爆薬を作ってたり――」
dialogues.en:
"In the history of the graduation party, the science and
drama clubs tried to make a bomb, because the drama club
wanted to make a scene in their play where a bomb goes off
at the end."
dialogues.text:
"In the history of the graduation party, the science and
drama clubs tried to make a bomb, because the drama club
wanted to make a scene in their play where a bomb goes off
at the end."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「自転車部が屋上で空飛ぶ｛・・／予定｝の自転車を作っ
　てたり、ラグビー部がトゲトゲのある肩当て
　を作っていたり……」
dialogues.en:
"And the bike club was making a bicycle which was supposed
to fly, and the rugby club made a shoulder pad with spikes
on it."
dialogues.text:
"And the bike club was making a bicycle which was supposed
to fly, and the rugby club made a shoulder pad with spikes
on it."

dialogues.jp: 指折り音夢が数え上げていく。
dialogues.en: Nemu counted using her fingers.
dialogues.text: Nemu counted using her fingers.

dialogues.jp: 「……警察呼べよ」
dialogues.en: "......You need to call the police."
dialogues.text: "......You need to call the police."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さんはボディーガードね」
dialogues.en: "You're my bodyguard."
dialogues.text: "You're my bodyguard."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「マジか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you serious?"
dialogues.text: "Are you serious?"

dialogues.jp: なんとなく肩を落としながら呟く。
dialogues.en: I mumbled looking down.
dialogues.text: I mumbled looking down.

dialogues.jp:
『法律を思い出せ！』と書かれたチラシは、存
在そのものが冗談だと思っていたんだが……。
dialogues.en:
I thought it was all a big joke when I saw that the flier
said "Remember the law."
dialogues.text:
I thought it was all a big joke when I saw that the flier
said "Remember the law."

dialogues.jp:
優秀な講師と学生と設備が揃っていて、モラル
に欠ける｛うち／風見｝ならではか。
dialogues.en:
I guess it's what our school's like. With all the high
skilled teachers, smart students and high tech school
buildings and too few morals.
dialogues.text:
I guess it's what our school's like. With all the high
skilled teachers, smart students and high tech school
buildings and too few morals.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「それで、このＴＯＰ３が凄いのよ♪」
dialogues.en: "And you've got to hear the top 3 of all time."
dialogues.text: "And you've got to hear the top 3 of all time."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「聞きたくない、聞きたくない……」
dialogues.en: "I don't want to hear this......"
dialogues.text: "I don't want to hear this......"

dialogues.jp:
これから相手をする中に、そのＴＯＰ３を上回
る奴がいるかも知れないと思うと、せつなくな
りそうだ。
dialogues.en:
It makes me sad to think I might have to confront someone
who may top the top 3.
dialogues.text:
It makes me sad to think I might have to confront someone
who may top the top 3.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ねぇ、聞いてよぉ」
dialogues.en: "Come on, you have to listen."
dialogues.text: "Come on, you have to listen."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「よっかかるな、チラシが落ちる！　って、耳
　に顔を近づけるな！」
dialogues.en:
"Don't lean on me, I'm going to drop the fliers. Wow, you're
way close to my ears!"
dialogues.text:
"Don't lean on me, I'm going to drop the fliers. Wow, you're
way close to my ears!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ね、ね、ホントは外部秘の話なんだよ〜。兄
　さんだから特別に教えてあげるから。秘密は
　共有するほうが面白いの♪」
dialogues.en:
"Hey, this is a top secret. But since it's niisan, I'll tell
you. It's much more exciting to share a secret."
dialogues.text:
"Hey, this is a top secret. But since it's niisan, I'll tell
you. It's much more exciting to share a secret."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そういうのは伝統にのっとって、外部秘のま
　ま墓まで持ってけ！」
dialogues.en:
"You have to keep it as a top secret and take it with you to
your grave."
dialogues.text:
"You have to keep it as a top secret and take it with you to
your grave."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「変わらないよぉ。兄さんと私のお墓は一緒の
　ところになるでしょ？」
dialogues.en:
"It doesn't make any difference. We have a family grave
site, so we'll be there together anyway."
dialogues.text:
"It doesn't make any difference. We have a family grave
site, so we'll be there together anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……俺の骨は海に流してくれ」
dialogues.en: "......I want my ashes to be dispersed in the ocean."
dialogues.text: "......I want my ashes to be dispersed in the ocean."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、それは綺麗だね」
dialogues.en: "That sounds wonderful."
dialogues.text: "That sounds wonderful."

dialogues.jp:
やたらハイテンションな音夢が、背伸びして俺
の顔を覗き込んでくる。
dialogues.en:
Nemu looked into my face as she stood on tiptoe. She was
really high spirited for some reason.
dialogues.text:
Nemu looked into my face as she stood on tiptoe. She was
really high spirited for some reason.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「どうしたの？」
dialogues.en: "What happened?"
dialogues.text: "What happened?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いや、人が来るかも知れないのに、そんなに
　はしゃいでいいのか？」
dialogues.en:
"I don't know... But, is it OK to be jumping around like
that when somebody might come at any time?"
dialogues.text:
"I don't know... But, is it OK to be jumping around like
that when somebody might come at any time?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「え？　あ……こほん。別にはしゃいでいるわ
　けじゃありません」
dialogues.en: "What? Uh...... I'm not jumping around at all."
dialogues.text: "What? Uh...... I'm not jumping around at all."

dialogues.jp: 頬を赤らめながら、音夢が口元に手を当てる。
dialogues.en: Nemu covered her mouth with her hand and her cheeks blushed.
dialogues.text: Nemu covered her mouth with her hand and her cheeks blushed.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、なんだよ……ん？」
dialogues.en: "Well then, what is it?"
dialogues.text: "Well then, what is it?"

dialogues.jp: 胸を押さえながら呟く。
dialogues.en: I mumbled pressing my chest.
dialogues.text: I mumbled pressing my chest.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「？　兄さん、どうしたの？」
dialogues.en: "? Niisan, what's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "? Niisan, what's wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「胸が痛いんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you have chest pain?"
dialogues.text: "Do you have chest pain?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いや……なんか変な｛どうき／動悸｝がしてさ」
dialogues.en: "No...... It's my heart. Beating too fast."
dialogues.text: "No...... It's my heart. Beating too fast."

dialogues.jp:
ドクドク、と自分の体調を無視して心臓が不自
然に高鳴る。
dialogues.en: My heart's pounding fast ignoring the rest of my body.
dialogues.text: My heart's pounding fast ignoring the rest of my body.

dialogues.jp:
ただ、このまま死んでしまうとかの不安はなく、
なんとなく――例えるなら、大好きな料理を前
にしたような心地よい動悸だ。
dialogues.en:
It doesn't feel scary like I'm going to die, but it's more
like anticipation of a good food or something. It feels
good.
dialogues.text:
It doesn't feel scary like I'm going to die, but it's more
like anticipation of a good food or something. It feels
good.

dialogues.jp:
「そう言えば、前にお前も同じようなこと言っ
　てなかったっけ？」
dialogues.en: "Didn't you say something like that before?"
dialogues.text: "Didn't you say something like that before?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そうだっけ？」
dialogues.en: "Did I?"
dialogues.text: "Did I?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……まぁ、多分、腹減ってるからだろうな」
dialogues.en: "......Well, maybe it's because I'm too hungry."
dialogues.text: "......Well, maybe it's because I'm too hungry."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「もうとっくに昼飯の時間過ぎてるぞ……」
dialogues.en: "It's well past lunchtime......"
dialogues.text: "It's well past lunchtime......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、お腹すいた？　お腹ペコペコだよね？」
dialogues.en: "Oh, are you hungry? You must be starving."
dialogues.text: "Oh, are you hungry? You must be starving."

dialogues.jp: 嫌な予感がした。
dialogues.en: I had a bad feeling.
dialogues.text: I had a bad feeling.

dialogues.jp:
音夢のこのハイテンションと、昼飯の話題が出
た瞬間の嬉しそうな顔……。
dialogues.en:
The way Nemu's acting and the happy face she had as soon as
I said something about the lunch.
dialogues.text:
The way Nemu's acting and the happy face she had as soon as
I said something about the lunch.

dialogues.jp: 「昼飯は食堂で俺が｛おご／奢｝ろう」
dialogues.en: "I'll buy you lunch at the cafeteria."
dialogues.text: "I'll buy you lunch at the cafeteria."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いえ、可愛い妹が兄さんのためにお弁当作っ
　て来ましたから、屋上に行きましょう♪」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, no. Let's go to the rooftop since I made lunch just for
you."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, no. Let's go to the rooftop since I made lunch just for
you."

dialogues.jp:
屋上への道とは逆に進もうとしたのだが、音夢
にがっちりと｛えりくび／襟首｝をつかまれる。
dialogues.en:
I tried to walk in the opposite direction to the rooftop,
but Nemu held me by my neck.
dialogues.text:
I tried to walk in the opposite direction to the rooftop,
but Nemu held me by my neck.

dialogues.jp: 「離せ〜！　こんなときだけ怪力になるな〜！」
dialogues.en: "Let me go! Why are you strong only when you want to be??"
dialogues.text: "Let me go! Why are you strong only when you want to be??"

dialogues.jp:
本気で踏ん張っているはずなのに、足がずるず
ると床をする。
dialogues.en: My feet got dragged even if I tried to resist it.
dialogues.text: My feet got dragged even if I tried to resist it.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「まぁまぁ。なんか私の料理が兄さんの口に合
　わないみたいだから、ちゃんと修行したんだ
　よ♪」
dialogues.en:
"Calm down. I did some training since last time, you didn't
seem to enjoy my food."
dialogues.text:
"Calm down. I did some training since last time, you didn't
seem to enjoy my food."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「修行うんぬんの前に、お前の味覚そのものが
　信用おけないんだよ！」
dialogues.en: "It's not about the training. It's about your taste buds!"
dialogues.text: "It's not about the training. It's about your taste buds!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「まぁまぁ」
dialogues.en: "Calm down."
dialogues.text: "Calm down."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「チラシは！？」
dialogues.en: "What about the fliers?"
dialogues.text: "What about the fliers?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「まぁまぁ」
dialogues.en: "Calm down."
dialogues.text: "Calm down."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なんも答えてないじゃんか！」
dialogues.en: "You aren't answering anything!!"
dialogues.text: "You aren't answering anything!!"

dialogues.jp: ◆音夢のお弁当◆
dialogues.en: ◆Lunch box made by Nemu◆
dialogues.text: ◆Lunch box made by Nemu◆

dialogues.jp:
音夢とふたりで違法品の抜き打ち検査をするハ
ズだったのだが……昼飯の話が出たところで雲
行きが怪しくなる。
dialogues.en:
Nemu and I were supposed to look for the illegal items in
classrooms, but things started to go wrong as we started to
talk about lunch......
dialogues.text:
Nemu and I were supposed to look for the illegal items in
classrooms, but things started to go wrong as we started to
talk about lunch......

dialogues.jp:
案の定、弁当を作ってきたらしく一時的に怪力
となった音夢によって、俺は屋上へと連行され
るのだった……。
dialogues.en:
Nemu made lunch boxes. She became a powerful wonder woman
instantly as she dragged me up to the rooftop for lunch.
dialogues.text:
Nemu made lunch boxes. She became a powerful wonder woman
instantly as she dragged me up to the rooftop for lunch.
